brand_layer._comment: MEASURED off ld-single-seed4816.mp4 (the --pace take), not seed 4815. 7 cuts, 8 shots. Caption spans come from whisper word timings and are split wherever a spoken line crosses one of those cuts, which the pace grammar deliberately makes happen.
